C-DROPBOX-RELEASE-SECRET.Summary: Read the Dropbox app key from the existing GitHub repository secret rather than the repository variable, matching the user configuration.

Goals.Goal: Fix the missing-key release failure with secrets.DROPBOX_APP_KEY.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve the missing-key guard, build-time-only linker injection, release targets and trigger. Never retrieve or print the secret value.
Preserve current staged/unstaged changes and archive completed work as previously requested.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No application source changes, release publication, tag changes or repository setting changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Release job env maps DROPBOX_APP_KEY to secrets.DROPBOX_APP_KEY; the guard names the repository secret. README and current GRACE release/deployment documentation match the Secrets tab.
YAML parsing and placeholder checks verify the secret mapping, missing-key failure and present-key success without reading real credentials. GRACE lint and diff checks pass before archive.

Assumptions.Assumption: The user has already added a repository secret named DROPBOX_APP_KEY. The failure is caused by the current workflow reading vars instead of secrets.
